text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is finally here! This will be
a great
opportunity for Bamboo Memory
to brush up on
her skills for the Swan
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp... It rolls right off the
tongue... Just
saying the words brings a
tear to the eye!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I want you to bring the heat,
okay?! Push
me until my very soul is
trembling!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our scorching-hot summer camp
begins!
